objections: PGR is in Financials, the one sector I weighed and turned down this week, and the draft gives it the job of cushioning a hot CPI, which I judged Financials can't do and gave to Healthcare instead (XLF lagged SPY by 2.35% in last week's rally against XLV's 1.59%), so it works against my calls rather than expressing one and leaves my hedge sector with no name in the book.
It fails my qualification test because its 40-week average is not rising, and with its weekly MACD histogram falling the chart gives no rising-trend case for holding it this week.

dissents.reason: At 35.4x trailing against only 23.5% EPS growth, CAT has the highest multiple for its growth of any name on the sheet, and paying that much for a heavy-machinery cyclical on what the draft calls a record quarter leaves no margin of safety for a 25% position in a week when a hot CPI would hit high multiples first.
